BiblicalUsage: Jacob borrows the picture of fish spawning and multiplying when he blesses Joseph's sons, praying that they would grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth. One word for teeming life carries the whole blessing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fruitfulness is God's design for His people, not an accident of history.
